mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS watchlist ( symbol TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() )
ALTER TABLE watchlist ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at::timestamptz, ALTER COLUMN created_at SET DEFAULT now()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist (symbol, name) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{name}) ON CONFLICT(symbol) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, name, created_at FROM watchlist ORDER BY created_at ASC, symbol ASC
INSERT INTO watchlist (symbol, name) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{name}) ON CONFLICT(symbol) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name RETURNING symbol, name, created_at
